# Policy Change

This folder contains topics related to policy changes within the Danish IBD database (DANIBD) and associated clinical quality indicators. It documents specific modifications to healthcare policies, such as updates to the requirements for diagnostic procedures like gastroscopy and colonoscopy under Indicator 1b, with all claims traced back to the original source reports.

## Pages

- [[policy-change|Policy Change]] — Documents specific modifications to clinical quality indicators, including the updated requirement for Indikator 1b to only mandate gastroscopy and colonoscopy.
